driver: common/driver.cu: routing_ds3_nogroup_topk_kernel<ROUTING_ACT_SIGMOID><<<bsz=4, 256, shmem=num_warps*K*12=768>>>(scores half[4*256], bias=nullptr, topk_indices int64[4*8], topk_weights half[4*8], 1.0f, E=256, K=8, bsz=4), then routing_std_topk_kernel<<<4,256,544>>> and routing_std_kernel<<<4,256,1568>>> with the shared-memory sizes of routing_std / routing_std_logits; usage: driver [all|ds3|std_topk|std] [E=256] [K=8] [bsz=4]; host reference (descending top-K of distinct half logits) prints wrong-set / wrong-order counts per kernel.
input: 4 tokens x 256 experts, K=8, distinct exactly-representable half logits ((idx*37+row*11) mod 256)/16 - 8. 8 warps per block, 64 candidates after the first per-warp reduction (> 32, so the stage loop of the topk kernels runs once with 2 warps; routing_std_kernel runs its radix-sort merge). Thread-level access estimate (about 1.3e4 in total, bound 3e4): per block and kernel ~1.2e3 (256 x 2 global loads of scores, ~200 STS of per-warp results, ~200 LDS/STS of the stage, ~100 of the final window, 16 global stores) x 4 blocks x 3 kernels.
